items.work: Piano Concerto in A minor, Op. 7
items.performers: Isata Kanneh-Mason, piano; Jonathan Aasgaard, cello; Royal Liverpool Philharmonic Orchestra; Holly Mathieson, conductor
items.label: Decca
items.note: The teenage Clara Wieck placed a duet for piano and cello at the centre of her concerto. Kanneh-Mason plays with the Royal Liverpool Philharmonic, and Jonathan Aasgaard joins her as cellist in the Romance.

links.title: Decca album on Apple Music — Isata Kanneh-Mason, concerto on tracks 1–3

items.work: Piano Trio in G minor, Op. 17
items.performers: The Nash Ensemble: Stephanie Gonley, violin; Adrian Brendel, cello; Simon Crawford-Phillips, piano
items.recorded: May 2019, St Silas the Martyr, Kentish Town, London
items.label: Hyperion
items.note: Written in Dresden in 1846, this trio is in four movements, and its finale includes a substantial fugue. The Nash Ensemble play it with fire and keep a fine balance between violin, cello and piano.
